title: Rough and growling clarinet: Lorenzo Tio
summary: Asked who played rough, Barnes names the younger Tio with his heavy reed, whom he says could get rough though he sounds smooth on records.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
